codeql_build_command: mkdir -p /tmp/envoy-obj && cd /src/envoy && EXTRA="-Ibazel-envoy/external $(find -L bazel-envoy/external -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 2>/dev/null | sed 's|^|-I|' | tr '\n' ' ') -Ibazel-envoy/external/boringssl/src/include -Ibazel-envoy/external/com_google_protobuf/src -Ibazel-envoy/external/com_github_grpc_grpc/include" && find source/exe source/common source/server -maxdepth 5 -name '*.cc' 2>/dev/null | head -400 | xargs -P 4 -I FILE bash -c "clang++ -c -std=c++20 -DABSL_INTERNAL_DISABLE_DEPRECATED_DECLARATION_ERROR -I . -I source -I include $EXTRA FILE -o /tmp/envoy-obj/\$(basename FILE).o 2>/dev/null" || true; ls /tmp/envoy-obj/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true
